canonical_ids.alternate_alias_scope: Only ordinary Standard legal-EP canonical IDs are exported. Shredder castling and FEN-EP alternative hash domains are not mixed into canonical streams; Root must normalize its reserved starts to the same canonical domain.
canonical_ids.castling: standard canonical KQkq; no Chess960. Equivalent representations normalize before hashing.
canonical_ids.stream_format: strictly ascending unique lowercase64hex plus LF;65bytes per ID

claim_scope: Feasibility of a new natural-play corpus only. Counts cannot prove teacher-pair yield, statistical power or learning reproducibility before private collision and prospective future label collection. Existing retired-engine D1 fixed2000 study and its heldout partitions untouched.

exports.collision_index: parents.ids,children.ids,selected-parents.ids,census-roots.ids,anchor16.ids:canonical sorted65-byte streams with exact count/bytes/SHA; no alternative hash domains
exports.large_products: sanitized selected FEN+legal-prefix products stay onCI; original archive/PGN remain runner-only and are not re-published, downloaded locally or returned
exports.privacy: No player names, ratings, comments, result tags, annotations or native labels are published.
exports.private_gate: Root compares canonical streams against all prior/current reserved starting IDs privately before ANY fitting/training. No private IDs/FENs/schedules/outcomes enter public CI.
exports.receipt: small hash-only source/partition/count/resource/index receipt returned to Root
exports.reversible: hash-only preliminary root/component/split/selected/complete child-ID records, compressed onCI
exports.selected_children: children.ids includes ALL legal one-ply children of every preliminary parent, a conservative superset of all selected roots; reversible manifest binds the exact selected parent/child memberships.
exports.source_origins: hash-only source-game-origins.jsonl binds1-based record ordinal, complete legal-mainline game_id, anchor16 canonicalID, eligible rootIDs, componentID and split; no names/results/annotations

family.component_id: SHA256(domain plus all sorted member anchor IDs)
family.game_id: SHA256 of domain plus complete legal mainline UCI sequence; exact move duplicates dropped independent of headers/result
family.initial_id: canonical position ID after exact early ply16; transposition-aware, clocks omitted
family.safeguards: Union all shared eligible-root IDs across anchor families. For preliminary roots, also union any family sharing a canonical parent or ANY legal one-ply child ID. No chosen moves/evaluations used.

partitions.selection: round-robin one root/component/round, at most8; stop fixed split quota, never redraw after private collision
partitions.validation: No teacher/native labels exist here. DEV/FINAL/SCREEN never become training. Verify all preliminary parent+child guard sets are disjoint between partitions.

quality.allowed_start: ordinary standard initial position only; Variant absent/Standard/Chess; no FEN or SetUp1; null moves or malformed/illegal SAN reject the whole record
quality.results_comments_annotations_ratings_nam: ignored, never retained or used in acceptance, ranking, splitting or summaries
quality.root_exclusions: in check, automatically terminal, or already a second occurrence in that game

resource_estimate.local_compute: tiny synthetic tests/metadata only; real source replay and large products only standard free publicCI

source.cohort: first20000 source records, not first20000 successes; never replace QC failures

source_correction.reason: Broadcast-specific terms are CC BY-SA4.0 rather than the CC0 needed for the possible downstream network submission.
